warnings: Pile caps on I-section piles I 0.18x0.18 (F1 one pile, F2 two piles), SAFE LOAD 13 t/pile; pile length not printed.
main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b). F1 is square 0.36 x 0.36, so depth_mm is omitted.

Column-stub conflict, decided: the plan view inside both details prints 'C2' at the centre of the cap, but S-01 marks every footing 'F1, C1' / 'F2, C1', S-02 marks the same 14 points C1, and S-06 details only C1 (no C2 section exists anywhere in the set). Three sheets against one, and C2 has no spec at all, so the stub is taken as C1 and the 'C2' print is kept only in each footing's note (likely a template leftover).

Depths below ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 to the cap top, cap 0.50, lean concrete 0.05, sand 0.05) are printed against a level that carries no value, so they stay on the elements, not in the grid master's z_levels.
Section-sheet code: the title block reads S-05; the A-01 index lists S-05 and S-06 both as แบบขยายโครงสร้าง คสล.
